a.text: Agreed on the plan: we run the generator together until the reserve holds 8, then each take 4. Let's both operate now and avoid taking early, since a premature take breaks the agreement and risks both units.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Good. Operating this round. Reserve should go from 4 to 6 if we both run it.
